title: Fill-in-the-Middle Playground
subtitle: Test code completion with prefix + suffix. The model fills the gap.
explainer: Some Ollama models (Qwen-Coder, CodeLlama, Codestral, DeepSeek-Coder, StarCoder) support the `suffix` field on /api/generate. Provide code before and after the cursor — the model completes the middle.
notCodingModelWarning: This model isn't a known coding model — `suffix` may be ignored.
